scenarios.name: Mid-Flight Audit Cancellation
scenarios.operator_action: Operator clicks 'Cancel Audit' button while OCR / audit processing is actively in progress.
scenarios.system_response: Desktop sends cancel signal, terminates active child process if unresponsive, clears intake queues, and resets UI state to IDLE.
scenarios.state_after_recovery: Clean IDLE state. No orphaned processes, workspace staging lock released.

scenarios.name: Sidecar Process Crash or Unexpected Termination
scenarios.operator_action: Sidecar child process is abruptly killed via SIGKILL / taskkill during application lifecycle.
scenarios.system_response: SidecarManager detects unexpected process exit, emits error telemetry, cleans up stale IPC pipes, and automatically respawns on next user request.
scenarios.state_after_recovery: Health handshake re-established. Subsequent audits execute seamlessly.

scenarios.name: Corrupted or Truncated File Intake
scenarios.operator_action: Operator accidentally selects a zero-byte file or corrupted PDF header in the file picker.
scenarios.system_response: Intake validation pipeline inspects magic bytes (validateFileSignature) and rejects file before staging, displaying non-blocking user warning.
scenarios.state_after_recovery: Application remains responsive. Valid documents in the batch are preserved.

scenarios.name: Session Data Purge & Isolation
scenarios.operator_action: Operator finishes a review session and clicks 'Clear / New Applicant'.
scenarios.system_response: WorkspaceManager recursively deletes staged packet directory, purges in-memory document blobs, and clears finding state.
scenarios.state_after_recovery: Zero residual files on disk in workspace. Fresh session initialized.

scenarios.name: Rapid Re-Audit / Double-Click Defense
scenarios.operator_action: Operator double-clicks 'Start Audit' button or triggers multiple audits in rapid succession.
scenarios.system_response: UI disables intake triggers and applies debouncing gate while audit is IN_PROGRESS; duplicate IPC requests are ignored.
scenarios.state_after_recovery: Single deterministic audit runs to completion without race condition.
scenarios.reproducibility: Verified in desktop UI component state
